fp32.b_B_zm.rule: E104's fp32.z_s (A = -0 at k>=1, E88's B at k>=1) with k=0 (1, S_j), S_j = b0 - R_j, R_j = sum_k>=1 B[k][j], b0 = 8: zero products hold C = n S_j > 0, b_B_wm's sums at every op's end; eff_sub as z_s's on every micro-op
fp32.b_B_zm.group: matched: held, zero products, at b_B_wm's sums

fp32.b_B_wm.rule: A = -1 at k>=1, E88's B at k>=1 (z_s's); k=0 (1, 8): every product -B[k][j], exact; C walks to n S_j > 0; eff_sub as z_s's on every micro-op
fp32.b_B_wm.group: matched: B's signs walking, alternations as z_s

fp16.b_B_zm.rule: E104's fp16.z_s (A words (-0, -0) at k-group>=1, E90's fp16.signs B at k-group>=1) with k-group 0 (1, 1) x (S_j/2, S_j/2), S_j = b0 - R_j, R_j = one op's sum of B's elements at k-group>=1, b0 = 16: zero products hold C = n S_j > 0, b_B_wm's sums at every op's end; eff_sub1 and eff_sub2 as z_s's on every micro-op
fp16.b_B_zm.group: matched: held, zero products, at b_B_wm's sums

fp16.b_B_wm.rule: A words (-1, -1) at k-group>=1, fp16.z_s's B at k-group>=1; k-group 0 (1, 1) x (8, 8): every product -B, exact; C walks to n S_j > 0; eff_sub1 and eff_sub2 as z_s's on every micro-op
fp16.b_B_wm.group: matched: B's signs walking, alternations as z_s

fp16.b_B_z.rule: E108's b_B_z in fp16: E104's fp16.z_s (A words (-0, -0) at k-group>=1) with k-group 0 (1, 1) x (Q_j/2, Q_j/2), Q_j = 2 + R_j ((-0, -0) where Q_j = 0, so no word is raw zero): zero products hold C = n Q_j, b_B_w's sums at every op's end
fp16.b_B_z.group: E108's design in fp16: held, zero products, at b_B_w's sums

fp16.b_B_w.rule: E108's b_B_w in fp16: A words (1, 1) at every k-group, fp16.z_s's B at k-group>=1, B words (1, 1) at k-group 0: C walks to n Q_j, Q_j = 2 + R_j, one value a column
fp16.b_B_w.group: E108's design in fp16: B's signs walking
